issues.jp_before: テストの結果[けっか]を開[ひら]く時[とき]、心臓[しんぞう]が{どきどき|on-feel}と音[おと]を立[た]てた。
issues.problem: 結果を開く is an unnatural collocation (one opens an envelope, not results).
issues.action: Changed to 結果を見る時; English adjusted to 'looked at'.

issues.jp_before: 次[つぎ]の巻[まき]はどうなるのかと、{わくわく|on-feel}しながらページをめくった。
issues.problem: Turning a page to find out what happens in the next volume is illogical.
issues.action: Changed to 次はどうなるのかと; English 'what would happen next'.

issues.jp_before: 子[こ]どもが高[たか]い木[き]に登[のぼ]るのを見[み]て、{はらはら|on-feel}した。
issues.problem: English assigned a gender ('he') not in the Japanese.

issues.jp_before: 試合[しあい]は最後[さいご]まで点差[てんさ]がなく、{はらはら|on-feel}する展開[てんかい]だった。
issues.problem: 点差がなく means the score was level, not 'close' as the English says.
issues.action: Changed to 点差がほとんどなく to match 'stayed close'.

issues.jp_before: 好[す]きなお店[みせ]が閉[し]まっていて、{がっかり|on-feel}しながら帰[かえ]った。
issues.problem: がっかりしながら帰った is awkward; がっかりして帰った is the natural form.
issues.action: Changed しながら to して.

issues.jp_before: 財布[さいふ]が見[み]つかって、{ほっと|on-feel}して力[ちから]が抜[ぬ]けた。
issues.problem: English 'my strength drained away' was an unnatural translation.
issues.action: English changed to 'I was so relieved that I went limp'.

issues.jp_before: ボーナスが出[で]て、父[ちち]は{うきうき|on-feel}した足取[あしど]りで帰[かえ]ってきた。
issues.problem: English 'He got his bonus, and my father...' had a pronoun before its referent.
issues.action: English rewritten: 'My father got his bonus and came home with a spring in his step.'
